stem:
Researchers at a zoo recorded the number of hours that the gorillas in two groups slept at night. The dot plots show the results.

Compare the data in the dot plots.
instruction: Choose the correct answer from each drop-down menu to complete the sentence.
response_template: The distribution of the data for both groups is [blank_1], and both groups have the same [blank_2].
visual_elements: Two dot plots labeled Group 1 and Group 2 showing number of hours of sleep for gorillas, dots representing gorillas.
notes: Two drop-down blanks require one choice each from distribution types (symmetrical, skewed left, skewed right) and summary statistics (mean, median).
